question: عايز بيانات فواتير العميل لولو
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 100 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.ContractDate, TM.CustomerAccountName, TM.TotalOrder, TM.totalPaid, TM.remindpaid FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND TM.CustomerAccountName LIKE N'%لولو%' ORDER BY TM.ContractDate DESC

question: Show all sales contracts from January 2025
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 200 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.ContractDate, TM.CustomerAccountName, TM.finaltotal FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND TM.ContractDate >= '2025-01-01' AND TM.ContractDate < '2025-02-01' ORDER BY TM.ContractDate DESC

question: ما هو اجمالي المحصل والمدفوع نقدا في العقود؟
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT SUM(TM.totalPaid) AS TotalCollected, SUM(TM.POPaid) AS TotalCashPaid, SUM(TM.remindpaid) AS TotalRemaining FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId

question: هات الفواتير غير المحصلة والمتبقي عليها أكبر من صفر
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 100 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.CustomerAccountName, TM.TotalOrder, TM.totalPaid, TM.remindpaid FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND (TM.IsPaid = 0 OR TM.IsPaid IS NULL) AND TM.remindpaid > 0 ORDER BY TM.remindpaid DESC

question: Show contract totals grouped by treasury safe account
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.FullName AS SafeAccountName, COUNT(DISTINCT TM.ContractID) AS ContractsCount, SUM(TD.POPaid) AS CashCollected FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN MonyAccount T1 ON TD.SafeAccount = T1.AcID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.FullName ORDER BY CashCollected DESC

question: كم عدد العقود واجمالي المبيعات حسب تصنيف العميل؟
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.CCName AS CustomerCategory, COUNT(DISTINCT TM.ContractID) AS ContractCount, SUM(TD.Total) AS TotalSales FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN CustomerCategory T1 ON TD.CategoryID = T1.CCID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.CCName ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

question: عرض العقود المرتبطة بأمر البيع والموردين
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 100 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.CustomerAccountName, T1.SupplyOrderName, TD.Total FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN SupplyOrderNotContractedreviewd T1 ON TD.supplyerOrderId = T1.SupplyOrderID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND TD.supplyerOrderId IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TM.ContractID DESC

question: Total sales per branch store inventory
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.SName AS StoreName, SUM(TD.Total) AS StoreSales, SUM(TD.Qty) AS TotalQty FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN StoreView T1 ON TD.StoreID = T1.SID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.SName ORDER BY StoreSales DESC

question: توزيع مبيعات الفواتير حسب الحي أو المحافظة
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.GovName AS Governorate, COUNT(DISTINCT TM.ContractID) AS InvoicesCount, SUM(TD.Total) AS TotalAmount FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN GovView T1 ON TD.Gov = T1.GOVID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.GovName ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC

question: Show sold quantities and units per product
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 200 TM.ContractID, T2.ProName AS ProductName, T1.UName AS UnitName, TD.Qty, TD.UnitFactor, TD.QuantityInBaseUnit FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN Units T1 ON TD.UnitID = T1.UID LEFT JOIN ProductPurchase T2 ON TD.ProductID = T2.ProID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId ORDER BY TM.ContractID DESC

question: هات البنود غير الفعالة أو المرتجعة في عقود المبيعات
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 100 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.CustomerAccountName, TD.NonActiveSystem, TD.IsSystemResale, TD.Total FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND (TD.NonActiveSystem = 1 OR TD.IsSystemResale = 1) ORDER BY TM.ContractID DESC

question: Show contract line items expiring before 2026-01-01
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 100 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TD.ProductID, TD.Expirdate, TD.Qty FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND TD.Expirdate IS NOT NULL AND TD.Expirdate < '2026-01-01' ORDER BY TD.Expirdate ASC

question: العقود التي ينتهي ضمانها قبل نهاية عام 2025
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 100 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.CustomerAccountName, TD.InsuranceStartDate, TD.InsuranceEndDate FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND TD.InsuranceEndDate <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY TD.InsuranceEndDate ASC

question: من قام بإدخال آخر 10 فواتير وتاريخ الإدخال؟
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 10 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.CreateBy, TM.CreateAt, TM.TotalOrder FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId ORDER BY TM.CreateAt DESC

question: Show the latest invoices with ModifyBy and ModifyAt audit info
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 20 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.ModifyBy, TM.ModifyAt, TM.finaltotal FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND TM.ModifyAt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TM.ModifyAt DESC

question: ابحث عن الفاتورة برقم السند 1050 أو رقم الفواتشر
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 50 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.Ordernumber, TM.Voucher, TM.CustomerAccountName, TM.TotalOrder FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND (TM.Ordernumber = N'1050' OR TM.Voucher = 1050)

question: اجمالي المبيعات حسب طريقة البيع
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.TypeName AS SaleMethod, COUNT(TM.ContractID) AS ContractCount, SUM(TM.finaltotal) AS TotalValue FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM LEFT JOIN ConType T1 ON TM.ContractType = T1.ContractTypeID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.TypeName ORDER BY TotalValue DESC

question: Show sales totals by selling currency and exchange rate
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.CName AS CurrencyName, AVG(TD.CurrancyEX) AS AvgExchangeRate, SUM(TM.TotalCurrancy) AS ForeignTotal FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN Currancy T1 ON TD.CurrancyID = T1.CID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.CName ORDER BY ForeignTotal DESC

question: اجمالي المبيعات وعدد الفواتير حسب قناة البيع
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.STName AS SalesChannel, COUNT(DISTINCT TM.ContractID) AS InvoiceCount, SUM(TD.Total) AS ChannelTotal FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN SalesTupe T1 ON TD.SalesTupeID = T1.STID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.STName ORDER BY ChannelTotal DESC

question: Total sales cost and revenue by cost center
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.CIName AS CostCenter, SUM(TD.systemCost) AS TotalCost, SUM(TD.Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN CostItems T1 ON TD.CostCenterID = T1.CIID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.CIName ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC

question: تقرير مبيعات كل مندوب مبيعات وعدد العقود
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.EmployeeNameA AS SalesmanName, COUNT(DISTINCT TM.ContractID) AS ContractCount, SUM(TD.Total) AS TotalSales FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN SalesmenView T1 ON TD.SalesMan = T1.EmployeeID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.EmployeeNameA ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

question: هات تفاصيل الأقساط وعددها وقيمة القسط للعقود
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT TOP 100 TM.ContractID, TM.AutoNumber, TM.CustomerAccountName, TD.ISName, TD.ISNumber, TD.ISmony, TD.ISStartDate FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId AND TD.ISNumber > 0 ORDER BY TD.ISStartDate DESC

question: Show total discount, VAT tax, and shipping price across sales contracts
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT SUM(TM.Discount) AS TotalDiscount, SUM(TM.TaxCurrancy) AS TotalVat, SUM(TM.shippingPrice) AS TotalShipping, SUM(TM.finaltotal) AS NetTotal FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId

question: اجمالي قيمة العقود حسب المشروع
sampleExpectedSql: SELECT T1.ProName AS ProjectName, COUNT(DISTINCT TM.ContractID) AS ContractCount, SUM(TD.Total) AS ProjectTotal FROM ContractViewWithPaid TM JOIN salessystemcontract TD ON TM.ContractID = TD.ContractID LEFT JOIN ProductNonInventory T1 ON TD.ContractProjectID = T1.ProID WHERE TM.ComID = @CurrentCompanyId GROUP BY T1.ProName ORDER BY ProjectTotal DESC
